cryo-EM's rolling three-year growth rate
growth over the previous three years, by year
Peaked at +65% a year in 2018 and has fallen every
window since — +22% in 2024 and +10% in 2025. This is
what the 2012–19 fit assumed was constant, and it is why
that fit fails in one direction and keeps failing by
more.
respect the deceleration and the forecast stops disagreeing
Two cryo-EM models — hold the current rate, or continue the measured decay — crossed with three
X-ray trajectories give six projections, and every one crosses in 2026, 2027 or 2028. The spread
in this register is not between forecasts; it is between the falsified fit and everything else. An
earlier version of this figure claimed a scenario where the decay makes cryo-EM level off below
X-ray: that was asserted and never computed, and it is wrong — the decay still compounds to about
4.2x the 2024 level.
RCSB PDB search API, fetched 2026-09-22, deposition date. 2025 is down across the whole register — all depositions -13%, X-ray -14%, cryo-EM -9% — so
the last point is not cryo-EM specific; cryo-EM fell least and its share of all depositions still rose, 40.0% to 41.8%. The deceleration is visible
from 2021 and does not depend on 2025. Solution NMR is drawn because it is the one method that fell, 557 depositions in 2010 against 205 in 2025, and
figure 8 shows why it was never displaced. None of this is about capability: a slowdown in depositions is equally consistent with a maturing method,
easy targets running out, and a funding cycle.
